generate_cow_renders: generate 40 rendered images and silhouettes of a cow mesh from uniformly distributed azimuth viewpoints
run_generate_cow_renders_custom_views: run generate_cow_renders with a custom number of views and azimuth range for the cow mesh
load_and_normalize_cow_mesh: load the cow OBJ mesh and normalize its vertices to fit in a unit sphere centered at origin
create_phong_renderer: create a MeshRenderer with SoftPhongShader, FoVPerspectiveCameras, and PointLights for rendering textured meshes
create_silhouette_renderer: create a MeshRenderer with SoftSilhouetteShader to render binary silhouette images of a 3D mesh
